description: Canonical JSON Schemas for every Kindgi artifact kind, importable by name as `@kindgi/specs/<name>.schema.json`.

SPECS_SCHEMAS_DIR.description: Absolute path to the directory holding every `<name>.schema.json`. For enumerating the whole set; resolve single schemas by name.

SPECS_EXAMPLES_DIR.description: Absolute path to the example fixtures (`<schema-name>.example.<label>.json`), each valid against its schema.
